business_problem: After a years-long move from on-premises Oracle systems, Grupo Bimbo needed globally standardized enterprise data so employees, business leaders, and customer-service teams could get faster answers and use AI-driven insights to improve planning, product quality, and operations.
solution_summary: Grupo Bimbo built its AI use cases on a standardized Oracle Fusion Cloud application estate after moving more than 90% of its on-premises Oracle applications to Fusion Cloud counterparts. The company uses Oracle Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Oracle Supply Chain Management & Manufacturing, and Oracle Transportation Management as core operational systems, then applies Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence to analyze the shared data produced by those applications. A data management office governs data standards and lifecycle management across the enterprise so the same finance, sales, inventory, transportation, and operational data can be reused consistently. On top of that foundation, Grupo Bimbo is already using a generative AI-powered digital assistant to answer employee questions from policy materials and embedded GenAI in Oracle Cloud ERP to let leaders retrieve sales and financial answers through prompts. The same standardized data layer also supports its customer-facing Connection Center and planned AI extensions in quality inspection, forecasting, and safety training.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
solution_components.role: Provides enterprise sales and financial data and includes GenAI prompt-based access for business leaders.

solution_components.name: Oracle Supply Chain Management & Manufacturing
solution_components.role: Runs supply chain and manufacturing processes where embedded AI is intended to support quality and forecasting improvements.

solution_components.name: Oracle Transportation Management
solution_components.role: Supports transportation operations and is part of the application set where embedded AI is intended to improve driver safety.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence
solution_components.role: Analyzes standardized Fusion application data for customer service, demand insight, and broader operational decision-making.

data_flow: Data from Grupo Bimbo's Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, supply chain/manufacturing, and transportation applications is standardized under enterprise data rules and analyzed in Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence. Employees consume answers through a generative AI assistant, business leaders query sales and financial information with ERP prompts, and Connection Center teams use the resulting insights to support service, planning, and operational decisions.
integration_points: Policy manuals used by employees for operational guidance
Sales and financial data used by business leaders
Inventory, demand planning, and transportation operations
business_outcome: Grupo Bimbo reports better visibility into inventory, improved demand planning and forecasting, significantly reduced product returns, improved product allocation by geography and region, and faster access to answers and insights for employees and business leaders.
metrics: More than 90% of its on-premises Oracle applications have transitioned to Fusion Cloud counterparts.
Grupo Bimbo has significantly reduced product returns.

The deployment uses Oracle Fusion Cloud globally as the enterprise application backbone.
Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence is used to turn the Connection Center into a customer service hub with social listening.
Embedded GenAI in Oracle Cloud ERP lets leaders retrieve sales and financial information through prompts.
